statement: An employer who violates the FLSA minimum-wage or overtime provisions (29 U.S.C. §§ 206, 207) is liable to the affected employees for their unpaid minimum wages or unpaid overtime compensation and an additional equal amount as liquidated damages (29 U.S.C. § 216(b)).
caveat: Section 216(b) also provides attorney's fees and costs, and § 216(a) carries criminal penalties for willful violations. State wage statutes add their own penalties on late or missed pay, and several reach individuals acting for the employer. This repo does not compute wage liability.
reviewer: Lane editorial review (situations batch 2026-10-27); independent domain expert review pending
